authority: Rigel 2026-10-24 retroactive G17 enforcement (StegVerse-org/.github#166); pattern StegVerse-Labs/StegDB#60 (eab2e773)
rule: Every check a folded workflow job ran is one group here; its step bodies are the original run blocks byte for byte, pinned by sha256, except the repairs listed. A new check is a new group (or a step in one), never a new workflow file.
path_filters: Dropped: every group runs on every pull_request and push to main (a superset of the original path-filtered runs). workflow_dispatch/schedule triggers are not carried (no manual dispatch, no cron).
repairs: Step bodies that read their own workflow file read its verbatim record under tools/tasks/folded/ instead; the assertions are unchanged.
Single-axis Python matrices (communication-edge-demo-validation, iw-matrix-falsifier-validation) are one catalog group per cell, recorded under source.matrix_cell.

Jobs whose steps call an action other than checkout/setup-python/upload-artifact, or that are reusable-workflow calls, are carried verbatim as dispatcher jobs (CARRIED_AS_DISPATCHER_JOB): test-suite-ratchet (ratchet), governance-gate-selftest (self, self-default-sdk-ref), deepwiki-readonly-review (review-only-export, with its workflow-level permissions moved to job level), mir-leaf-v3-conformance (conformance). Their path filters are dropped: they now run on every pull request and push to main.
